metaDescription: Found wrong data, have a suggestion or love something on ForThePeople.in? Send your feedback. We read every message.
title: Share your feedback
description: Found wrong data? Have a suggestion? Love something? Your feedback makes this platform better for every Indian citizen.
simple: Pick what kind of message it is, write a line or two, and press Send. A real person reads every message.
step_writeBody: Say what you saw and on which page.
step_readBody: A real person reads every message.
step_fixBody: Wrong data is corrected within 24 hours of checking.
step_replyBody: If you left an email, we write back.
subject: Subject
messagePlaceholder: Please describe in detail. For data errors, mention the district, the module and what the correct value should be.
name: Your name
errorFailed: Could not send your feedback. Please try again.
footnote: Every message is read personally. We may write back if you gave an email. Thank you for helping improve India's citizen transparency platform.
thanksBody: Every message helps make ForThePeople.in better for all citizens. We read every submission personally.
